cells.source: But because Jesus continues to live forever, he has a permanent priesthood.

examples.source: But I have built you a lofty residence, a place for you to live in forever.”
examples.gold: نَ كُي ﭑ بَرَ لِنفِرَ تِ عِ بّ، عِ سَبَتِمَ دّننَشّ عَبَدَن.»

examples.source: You must anoint them as you anointed their father so that they may serve me as priests. Their anointing will make for them a permanent priesthood throughout their people's generations.”
examples.gold: عِ قَ تُرٍ سّنِيّنشِ سَ عٍ مَ عَلْ عِ نَشَن نَبَشِ عٍ بَبَ رَ، عَلَكٌ عٍ قَن شَ قِندِ ﭑ مَ سّرّشّدُبّيٍ رَ. نَ وَلِ لُمَ عٍ يِ رَ، عَ نُن نَشٍيٍ قَمَ عٍ شَنبِ رَ عَبَدَن.»

examples.source: He was trying to see who Jesus was, but could not see over the crowd, because he was small in height.
examples.gold: عَ نُ كَتَقٍ نّ عَ شَ عِسَ كٌلٌن، كْنْ عَ مُ نُ نْمَ عَ تٌدٍ حَمَ شَ قٍ رَ، بَرِ مَ مِشِ دُنكٍ نَن نُ عَ رَ.

examples.source: Yahweh is a jealous God and avenges; Yahweh avenges and is full of wrath; Yahweh takes vengeance on his adversaries, and he continues his anger for his enemies.
examples.gold: عَلَتَلَ عَ فبٍحْشْمَ نّ، عَ شَ شْنّ سّنبّ فبٌ عَ يَشُييٍ مَبِرِ، عَ مُ دِحّمَ عٍ مَ مَقُرٍن مَقُرٍن.

examples.source: The Lord has become like an enemy. He has swallowed up Israel. He has swallowed up all her palaces. He has destroyed her strongholds. He has increased mourning and lamentation within the daughter of Judah.
examples.gold: عَلَتَلَ بَرَ لُ عَلْ وٌن يَشُي. عَ بَرَ عِسِرَيِلَ نُن عَ شَ بَنشِ قَنيِيٍ بِرِن كَنَ. عَ بَرَ عَ شَ يِرٍ مَكَنتَشِيٍ رَبِرَ. عَ بَرَ يُدَيَ شَ كِنِكِنِ نُن سُننُنيِ شُنمَسَ.

examples.source: For him and his descendants after him, it will be a covenant of an everlasting priesthood because he was zealous for me, his God. He has atoned for the people of Israel.”'”
examples.gold: نَ سَاتّ لُمَ ﭑ تَن نُن عَ بْنسْي تَفِ، عٍ قَ قِندِ سّرّشّدُبّيٍ رَ عَبَدَن، بَرِ مَ ﭑ مَ شَنُنتٍيَ نُ نَ عَ بْحّ كُي، عَ مَن قَ عَ نِيَ عِسِرَيِلَكَيٍ شَ يُنُبِ شَ شَقَرِ.»

examples.source: You must clothe Aaron and his sons with sashes and put headbands on them. The work of the priesthood will belong to them by permanent law. In this way you must consecrate Aaron and his sons for them to serve me.
examples.gold: عِ شَ هَرُنَ نُن عَ شَ دِيٍ تَفِ عِشِرِ بّلّتِ رَ، عِ شَ شُنمَسٍ دْشْ عٍ شُنيِ مَ. عِ هَرُنَ نُن عَ شَ دِيٍ تِمَ سّرّشّدُبّيٍ رَ نَ كِ نّ. نَ شَ قِندِ سّرِيّ رَ نَشَن مُ كَنَمَ عَبَدَن.»

examples.source: But you, Yahweh, live forever, and your fame is for all generations.
examples.gold: ﭑ مَ سِمَيَ بَرَ لُ عَلْ نِينِ نَشَن لْيمَ دِ مِ كُي، عَلْ سّشّ نَشَن لِسِمَ قِيلِ مَ.

examples.source: But Jesus answered and said to them, “You are mistaken, because you do not know the scriptures or the power of God.

examples.source: But Jesus did not trust in them because he knew them all,
examples.gold: كْنْ عِسَ مُ نُ لَمَ عٍ رَ، بَرِ مَ عَ نُ عَدَ مَدِ بِرِن كٌلٌن.

cells.source: But because Jesus continues to live forever, he has a permanent priesthood.

examples.source: But I have built you a lofty residence, a place for you to live in forever.”
examples.gold: نَ كُي ﭑ بَرَ لِنفِرَ تِ عِ بّ، عِ سَبَتِمَ دّننَشّ عَبَدَن.»

examples.source: You must anoint them as you anointed their father so that they may serve me as priests. Their anointing will make for them a permanent priesthood throughout their people's generations.”
examples.gold: عِ قَ تُرٍ سّنِيّنشِ سَ عٍ مَ عَلْ عِ نَشَن نَبَشِ عٍ بَبَ رَ، عَلَكٌ عٍ قَن شَ قِندِ ﭑ مَ سّرّشّدُبّيٍ رَ. نَ وَلِ لُمَ عٍ يِ رَ، عَ نُن نَشٍيٍ قَمَ عٍ شَنبِ رَ عَبَدَن.»

examples.source: The bellows are scorched by the fire that is burning them; the lead is consumed in the flames. The refining continues among them, but it is useless, because the evil is not removed.
examples.gold: شَبُي تّ رَدّشّمَ عَ قَنيِ رَ عَلَكٌ عَ شَ وُرٍ نُن يْشُي رَشُنُ، عٍ فبِ شَ بَ. كْنْ قٍ حَاشِ مُ حْنمَ ﭑ مَ حَمَ تَفِ. عٍ لُشِ نّ عَلْ سُنبُي نَشَن مُ بَمَ وُرٍ كُي.

examples.source: Yahweh has done what he planned to do. He has fulfilled his word. He has overthrown you without pity, for he has permitted the enemy to rejoice over you; he has lifted up the horn of your enemies.
examples.gold: عَلَتَلَ نَشَن حَنِفٍ، عَ نَ نَن نَبَشِ. عَ بَرَ عَ شَ وْيّنيِ رَكَمَلِ، عَ نَشَن مَسٍن تّمُي شْننَكُيٍ. عَ بَرَ كَنَرِ رَبَ، عَ مُ كِنِكِنِ. عَ بَرَ عَ نِيَ عِ يَشُييٍ شَ عِ مَيٍلٍ. عَ بَرَ عِ فٍرٍقَيٍ سّنبّ رَفبٌ يّ.

examples.source: No one who remains in him will keep on sinning. No one who continues to sin has seen him or known him.
examples.gold: مِشِ نَشَن سَبَتِشِ عِسَ عِ، نَ كَنيِ مُ لُمَ يُنُبِ رَبَ رَ سْنْن. نَشَن لُمَ يُنُبِ رَبَ رَ، نَ كَنيِ مُ عِسَ تٌشِ، عَ مَن مُ عَ كٌلٌن.

examples.source: Herod questioned Jesus in many words, but Jesus answered him nothing.
examples.gold: نَ كُي، هٍرٌدٍ نَشَ مَشْرِنيِ فبٍفبٍ تِ عِسَ مَ، كْنْ عِسَ مُ يَابِ كٍرٍن قِ.

examples.source: but I have built you a lofty residence, a place for you to live in forever.”
examples.gold: ﭑ تَن بَرَ لِنفِرَ تِ عَلَ بّ، عَ لُمَ دّننَشّ عَبَدَن.»

cells.candidate: كْنْ عِسَ تَن مُ قَشَمَ، عَ بُمَ نّ عَبَدَن. عَ شَ سّرّشّدُبّحَ مُ رَدَنفِمَ مِشِ فبّتّيٍ مَ.

cells.source: The voice said to the sixth angel who had the trumpet, “Release the four angels who are bound at the great Euphrates River.”

examples.source: One of the seven angels who had been holding the seven bowls came and said to me, “Come, I will show you the condemnation of the great prostitute who is seated on many waters.
examples.gold: نَ دَنفِ شَنبِ، مَلٍكّ كٍرٍن نَشَن نُ نَ نَ مَلٍكّ تْنبِلِ كَنيِ سٌلٌقٍرٍ يَ مَ، عَ نَشَ عَ قَلَ ﭑ بّ، «قَ بٍ، عَلَكٌ ﭑ شَ لَنفٌي شُنفبٍ شَ كِيتِ مَسٍن عِ بّ، نَ لَنفٌي نَشَن دْشْشِ شُرٍ شُنفبٍيٍ دّ رَ.»

examples.source: From the wilderness and Lebanon, as far as the great river, the Euphrates, all the land of the Hittites, and to the Great Sea, where the sun goes down, will be your land.
examples.gold: وٌ شَ نَانِنيِيٍ كٍلِمَ فبٍنفبٍرٍن يِرٍ نّ، عَ سَ دْشْ لِبَن فٍيَيٍ رَ، هَن عٍقِرَتِ شُرٍ بٍلٍبٍلٍ رَ، شِتِكَيٍ شَ بْشِ بِرِن سَ دْشْ بَا شُنفبٍ رَ سٌفٍفٌرٌدٍ.

examples.source: So I said to the angel who was talking to me, “Where are they taking the basket?”
examples.gold: ﭑ نَشَ مَلٍكّ مَشْرِن، نَشَن نُ وْيّنمَ ﭑ نَ، «عٍ نَ بُسَلِ شَنِنقٍ مِندٍن؟»

examples.source: She saw two angels in white sitting, one at the head, and one at the foot of where the body of Jesus had lain.
examples.gold: عَ نَشَ مَلٍكّ قِرِن تٌ. عٍ مَشِرِشِ دُفِ قِيشّ رَ، عٍ دْشْشِ عِسَ قُرٍ نُ سَشِ دّننَشّ. كٍرٍن نُ نَ عَ شُنسَدٍ رَ، بٌورٍ نُ نَ عَ سَنلَابٍ رَ.

examples.source: 'These large animals, four in number, are four kings that will arise from the earth.
examples.gold: عَ نَشَ نَ تَفِ رَبَ ﭑ بّ، ‹يِ سُبٍ مَفَاشُشِ نَانِيٍ، دُنِحَ مَنفّ نَانِ نَن نَ عٍ رَ نَشٍيٍ قَمَ بُلَدٍ بْشِ مَ.

examples.source: If they are bound in chains and trapped in cords of suffering,
examples.gold: كْنْ شَ عٍ سُشُشِ تْورّ نَن كُي،

examples.source: The sixth casting of lots fell to tribe of Naphtali, clan by clan.
examples.gold: بْشِ تَشُن سٍننِ ندٍ نَشَ قِندِ نَقَتَلِ بْنسْي شَبِلّيٍ فبٍ رَ عَلَتَلَ شَ مَرَفِرِ سَابُي رَ.

examples.source: Pilate addressed them again, desiring to release Jesus.
examples.gold: ثِلَتِ تٌ نُ وَ مَ عِسَ رَبّحِنقٍ، عَ مَن نَشَ وْيّن حَمَ بّ،

examples.source: Also angels who did not keep to their own position of authority, but who left their proper dwelling place—God has kept them in everlasting chains, in utter darkness, for the judgment on the great day.
examples.gold: مَلٍكّ ندٍيٍ قَن تٌ عٍ يّتّ لُ بِنيّتَرٍحَ كُي، عٍ عٍ شْنيِ بّحِن، عَلَ نَشَ عٍ رَ سٌ فٍيلِ كُي، عٍ شَ لُ دِ مِ كُي هَن كِيتِ شُنفبٍ سَ لْشْي.

examples.source: But suppose that you say, “We will not stay in this land”—if you do not listen to my voice, the voice of Yahweh your God.
examples.gold: «كْنْ شَ وٌ عَ قَلَ، ‹مُشُ تَن مُ لُمَ بٍ،› شَ وٌ مُ وٌ تُلِ مَتِ وٌ مَرِفِ عَلَتَلَ شُي رَ،

examples.source: I saw another angel coming up from the east, who had the seal of the living God. He cried out with a loud voice to the four angels who were given permission to harm the earth and the sea:
examples.gold: ﭑ نَشَ مَلٍكّ فبّتّ قَن تٌ عَ كٍلِقٍ سٌفٍتٍدٍ مَبِرِ، عَلَ حِحّ شَ تْنشُمَ سُشُشِ عَ يِ رَ. عَ نَشَ عَ مَسٍن عَ شُي عِتٍشِ رَ، نَ مَلٍكّ نَانِيٍ بّ، نَشٍيٍ نُ يَمَرِشِ قٍ شْنّ رَبَدٍ بْشِ نُن بَا رَ،

examples.source: On that day Yahweh made a covenant with Abram, saying, “To your descendants I hereby give this land, from the river of Egypt to the great river, the Euphrates—
examples.gold: نَ لْشْي، عَلَتَلَ نَشَ يِ سَاتّ تٌنفٌ عِبُرَ مَ بّ، «ﭑ بَرَ يِ بْشِ قِ عِ بْنسْي مَ، كٍلِ مِسِرَ شُرٍ مَ، سَ دْشْ عٍقِرَتِ شُرٍ بٍلٍبٍلٍ رَ.»

examples.source: At this answer, Pilate tried to release him, but the Jews cried out, saying, “If you release this man, you are not a friend of Caesar. Everyone who makes himself a king speaks against Caesar.”
examples.gold: ثِلَتِ تٌ نَ مّ، عَ نَشَ سٌ كَتَقٍ عَ شَ عِسَ رَبّحِن، كْنْ يُوِقِيٍ نَشَ سْنشْ، «شَ عِ يِ شّمّ بّحِن، عِ بَرَ فٍرٍ فِرِ رْ مَ مَنفّ شُنفبٍ مَ. نَشَن يٌ عَ يّتّ قِندِ مَنفّ رَ، عَ بَرَ تِ رْ مَ مَنفّ شُنفبٍ كَنكٍ.»

examples.source: Are not all angels spirits who serve, and who are sent to care for those who will inherit salvation?
examples.gold: مَلٍكّيٍ تَن قِندِشِ عَلَ شَ وَلِكّيٍ نَن نَ، قَتٍ مُ نَ نَشٍيٍ بّ، عَ نَشٍيٍ شّيمَ كِسِ كّتٌنفٌي مَلِدٍ.

examples.source: The sixth angel sounded his trumpet, and I heard a voice coming from the horns of the golden altar that is present before God.
examples.gold: مَلٍكّ سٍننِ ندٍ تٌ سَرَ قٍ، ﭑ نَشَ شُي ندٍ مّ كٍلِقٍ سّرّشّبَدٍ شّيمَ دَاشِ قٍرِ تُنشُن نَانِيٍ مَ، نَشَن نَ عَلَ يَ عِ.

examples.source: the fifth to Malchijah, the sixth to Mijamin,
examples.gold: عَ سُولِ ندٍ مَلَكِيَ، عَ سٍننِ ندٍ مِيَمِن،

examples.source: We will be changed in a moment, in the twinkling of an eye, at the last trumpet. For the trumpet will sound, and the dead will be raised imperishable, and we will be changed.
examples.gold: مَقُرٍن مَقُرٍن سَرَ دْنشْي شُي مَ. نَ سَرَ نَ قٍ، قَشَمِشِيٍ كٍلِمَ نّ قَشّ مَ قَتٍ نّينّيٍ رَ عٍ مَ نَشٍيٍ مُ بْرْ مَ سْنْن. وٌن قَمَ نّ مَسَرَدٍ.

examples.source: In the four corners of the outer courtyard there were four small courtyards, forty cubits in length and thirty in width. There the same dimensions for all four of the courtyards.
examples.gold: نَشٍيٍ شَ كُيّ نْنفْن يَ تٌنفٌ نَانِ لِمَ، عٍ عِفبٌي نْنفْن يَ تٌنفٌ سَشَن. نَ تّتّ نَانِ بِرِن نُ لَن.

examples.source: Yet Thebes was carried away; she went into captivity; her young children were dashed in pieces at the head of every street; her enemies threw lots for her honorable men, and all her great men were bound in chains.
examples.gold: كْنْ تٍبٍسٍ قَن بَرَ شَنِن كٌنيِيَ كُي حَمَنّ مَ، عَ شَ دِيٍ بَرَ قَشَ كِرَ شُنيِيٍ رَ، عَ شَ كُنتِفِيٍ بَرَ مَيٍفٍتِ سِفَقٍ رَ كٌنيِيَ كُي.

examples.source: Judas, who would betray him said, “Is it I, Rabbi?” He said to him, “You have said it yourself.”
examples.gold: يُدَ سِ نَشَن نُ قَقٍ عَ يَنقَدٍ، عَ نَشَ عِسَ مَشْرِن، «كَرَ مْشْ، ﭑ تَن مُ عَ رَ دٍ، كَ؟» عِسَ نَشَ عَ يَابِ، «عِ تَن نَن عَ قَلَشِ.»

cells.candidate: نَ شُي عَ مَلٍكّ سٍننِ نَانِيٍ سَرَ قٍ، «شُرُقٍ مَلٍكّيٍ نَانِيٍ نَشٍيٍ بّ رَ قَشَ قٍلِقٍ سٌفٍتٍدٍ مَبِرِ تُنشُن نَانِيٍ مَ.»

cells.source: The voice said to the sixth angel who had the trumpet, “Release the four angels who are bound at the great Euphrates River.”

examples.source: I saw another angel coming up from the east, who had the seal of the living God. He cried out with a loud voice to the four angels who were given permission to harm the earth and the sea:
examples.gold: ﭑ نَشَ مَلٍكّ فبّتّ قَن تٌ عَ كٍلِقٍ سٌفٍتٍدٍ مَبِرِ، عَلَ حِحّ شَ تْنشُمَ سُشُشِ عَ يِ رَ. عَ نَشَ عَ مَسٍن عَ شُي عِتٍشِ رَ، نَ مَلٍكّ نَانِيٍ بّ، نَشٍيٍ نُ يَمَرِشِ قٍ شْنّ رَبَدٍ بْشِ نُن بَا رَ،

examples.source: On that day Yahweh made a covenant with Abram, saying, “To your descendants I hereby give this land, from the river of Egypt to the great river, the Euphrates—
examples.gold: نَ لْشْي، عَلَتَلَ نَشَ يِ سَاتّ تٌنفٌ عِبُرَ مَ بّ، «ﭑ بَرَ يِ بْشِ قِ عِ بْنسْي مَ، كٍلِ مِسِرَ شُرٍ مَ، سَ دْشْ عٍقِرَتِ شُرٍ بٍلٍبٍلٍ رَ.»

examples.source: At this answer, Pilate tried to release him, but the Jews cried out, saying, “If you release this man, you are not a friend of Caesar. Everyone who makes himself a king speaks against Caesar.”
examples.gold: ثِلَتِ تٌ نَ مّ، عَ نَشَ سٌ كَتَقٍ عَ شَ عِسَ رَبّحِن، كْنْ يُوِقِيٍ نَشَ سْنشْ، «شَ عِ يِ شّمّ بّحِن، عِ بَرَ فٍرٍ فِرِ رْ مَ مَنفّ شُنفبٍ مَ. نَشَن يٌ عَ يّتّ قِندِ مَنفّ رَ، عَ بَرَ تِ رْ مَ مَنفّ شُنفبٍ كَنكٍ.»

examples.source: Are not all angels spirits who serve, and who are sent to care for those who will inherit salvation?
examples.gold: مَلٍكّيٍ تَن قِندِشِ عَلَ شَ وَلِكّيٍ نَن نَ، قَتٍ مُ نَ نَشٍيٍ بّ، عَ نَشٍيٍ شّيمَ كِسِ كّتٌنفٌي مَلِدٍ.

examples.source: The sixth angel sounded his trumpet, and I heard a voice coming from the horns of the golden altar that is present before God.
examples.gold: مَلٍكّ سٍننِ ندٍ تٌ سَرَ قٍ، ﭑ نَشَ شُي ندٍ مّ كٍلِقٍ سّرّشّبَدٍ شّيمَ دَاشِ قٍرِ تُنشُن نَانِيٍ مَ، نَشَن نَ عَلَ يَ عِ.

examples.source: the fifth to Malchijah, the sixth to Mijamin,
examples.gold: عَ سُولِ ندٍ مَلَكِيَ، عَ سٍننِ ندٍ مِيَمِن،

examples.source: We will be changed in a moment, in the twinkling of an eye, at the last trumpet. For the trumpet will sound, and the dead will be raised imperishable, and we will be changed.
examples.gold: مَقُرٍن مَقُرٍن سَرَ دْنشْي شُي مَ. نَ سَرَ نَ قٍ، قَشَمِشِيٍ كٍلِمَ نّ قَشّ مَ قَتٍ نّينّيٍ رَ عٍ مَ نَشٍيٍ مُ بْرْ مَ سْنْن. وٌن قَمَ نّ مَسَرَدٍ.

examples.source: In the four corners of the outer courtyard there were four small courtyards, forty cubits in length and thirty in width. There the same dimensions for all four of the courtyards.
examples.gold: نَشٍيٍ شَ كُيّ نْنفْن يَ تٌنفٌ نَانِ لِمَ، عٍ عِفبٌي نْنفْن يَ تٌنفٌ سَشَن. نَ تّتّ نَانِ بِرِن نُ لَن.

examples.source: Yet Thebes was carried away; she went into captivity; her young children were dashed in pieces at the head of every street; her enemies threw lots for her honorable men, and all her great men were bound in chains.
examples.gold: كْنْ تٍبٍسٍ قَن بَرَ شَنِن كٌنيِيَ كُي حَمَنّ مَ، عَ شَ دِيٍ بَرَ قَشَ كِرَ شُنيِيٍ رَ، عَ شَ كُنتِفِيٍ بَرَ مَيٍفٍتِ سِفَقٍ رَ كٌنيِيَ كُي.

examples.source: Judas, who would betray him said, “Is it I, Rabbi?” He said to him, “You have said it yourself.”
examples.gold: يُدَ سِ نَشَن نُ قَقٍ عَ يَنقَدٍ، عَ نَشَ عِسَ مَشْرِن، «كَرَ مْشْ، ﭑ تَن مُ عَ رَ دٍ، كَ؟» عِسَ نَشَ عَ يَابِ، «عِ تَن نَن عَ قَلَشِ.»

cells.candidate: نَ شُي نَشَ عَ قَلَ مَلٍكّ سٍننِ ندٍ بّ، سَرَ نُ سُشُشِ نَشَن يِ، «نَ مَلٍكّ نَانِ رَبّحِن، نَشٍيٍ شِرِشِ عٍقِرَتِ شُرٍ مَ.»

cells.source: The voice said to the sixth angel who had the trumpet, “Release the four angels who are bound at the great Euphrates River.”

examples.source: The sixth angel poured out his bowl into the great river, the Euphrates. Its water was dried up in order to prepare the way for the kings that would come from the east.
examples.gold: مَلٍكّ سٍننِ ندٍ نَشَ عَ شَ تْنبِلِ عِقِلِ عٍقِرَتِ شُرٍ شُنفبٍ مَ. نَ شُرٍ نَشَ شَرَ، عَلَكٌ عَ شَ قِندِ كِرَ رَ مَنفّيٍ بّ، نَشٍيٍ قَمَ كٍلِقٍ سٌفٍتٍدٍ.

examples.source: He will send his angels with a great sound of a trumpet, and they will gather together his elect from the four winds, from one end of the sky to the other.
examples.gold: عَ عَ شَ مَلٍكّيٍ شّيمَ نّ هَن دُنِحَ دَندٍ، عٍ شَ سَ عَ شَ مِشِ سُفَندِشِيٍ مَلَن سَرَ شُي رَ كٍلِ دُنِحَ تُنشُن نَانِ بِرِن مَ.»

examples.source: On that day Yahweh made a covenant with Abram, saying, “To your descendants I hereby give this land, from the river of Egypt to the great river, the Euphrates—
examples.gold: نَ لْشْي، عَلَتَلَ نَشَ يِ سَاتّ تٌنفٌ عِبُرَ مَ بّ، «ﭑ بَرَ يِ بْشِ قِ عِ بْنسْي مَ، كٍلِ مِسِرَ شُرٍ مَ، سَ دْشْ عٍقِرَتِ شُرٍ بٍلٍبٍلٍ رَ.»

examples.source: Remember prisoners, as if you were bound with them. Remember those who are mistreated, as if you also were them in the body.
examples.gold: وٌ شَ رَتُ فٍيلِمَنِيٍ مَ نُن مِشِيٍ مَ نَشٍيٍ حَشَنكَتَشِ. وٌ شَ قٍ قَنيِ رَبَ عٍ بّ عَلْ وٌ بِرِن نَ قَتٍ بّندّ كٍرٍن نَن كُي.

examples.source: to hear the groaning of the prisoners, to release those who were condemned to death.
examples.gold: بَرِ مَ عَ عَ يَ رَفٌرٌ مَ وٌن مَ كٍلِقٍ عَ شَ يِرٍ سّنِيّنشِ عِتٍشِ. عَلَتَلَ بْشِ مَتٌمَ كٍلِقٍ كٌورٍ مَ،

examples.source: Saul recognized David's voice and said, “Is that your voice, my son David?” David said, “It is my voice, my master, king.”
examples.gold: سْلُ نَشَ دَوُدَ شُي كٌلٌن، عَ نَشَ عَ مَشْرِن، «ﭑ مَ دِ دَوُدَ، عِ شُي نَن نَ كِ؟» دَوُدَ نَشَ عَ يَابِ، «ﭑ مَرِفِ، ﭑ تَن نَن عَ رَ.

examples.source: But you have the custom that I release one person to you at the Passover. So do you want me to release the King of the Jews to you?”
examples.gold: وٌ تٌ دَرِشِ عَ رَ ﭑ شَ فٍيلِمَنِ كٍرٍن بّحِن وٌ بّ سَيَمَلٍكّ دَنفِ سَلِ لْشْي، وٌ وَ مَ ﭑ شَ يُوِقِيٍ شَ مَنفّ بّحِن وٌ بّ؟»

examples.source: I will therefore punish him, and release him.”
examples.gold: نَ كُي، ﭑ يَامَرِ قِمَ نّ عَ شَ بْنبْ، ﭑ قَ عَ رَبّحِن.»

examples.source: Then you must blow a loud trumpet everywhere on the tenth day of the seventh month. On the Day of Atonement you must blow a trumpet throughout all your land.
examples.gold: عَ كِكٍ سٌلٌقٍرٍ شِ قُ ندٍ، وٌ شَ سَرَيٍ قٍ حَمَ بّ بْشِ بِرِن كُي، عَ قِندِ مَ شُنسَرٍ لْشْي نَن نَ.

examples.source: At Taberah, at Massah, and at Kibroth Hattaavah, you provoked Yahweh to wrath.
examples.gold: «وٌ مَن بَرَ عَلَتَلَ رَشْنْ تَبٍرَ، مَسَ، نُن كِبِرٌتِ هَتَاوَ.

cells.source: Pilate answered them again and said, “What then should I do with the King of the Jews?”

examples.source: Then the chief priests of the Jews said to Pilate, “Do not write, 'The King of the Jews,' but rather, 'This one said, “I am King of the Jews.”'”
examples.gold: Ha'e ramo sacerdote yvatekueve va'e aipoe'i Pilatos pe: — Embopara uka eme “Judeu kuery pegua huvixave.” Ha'e rã embopara uka “Ha'e onhemombe'u judeu kuery pegua huvixave oikoa rami.”

examples.source: They cried out, “Away with him, away with him; crucify him!” Pilate said to them, “Should I crucify your King?” The chief priests answered, “We have no king but Caesar.”
examples.gold: Ha'e rã ha'e kuery ma ojapukaive: — Eraa, eraa, eupi kuruxu re — he'i okuapy. Ha'e ramo Pilatos aipoe'i: — Peipota va'e ty'y peẽ kuery ruvixave kuruxu re aupi uka? Sacerdote yvatekueve va'e ombovai: — Ore kuery ma oreruvixave ndoroguerekoi, César e'ỹ vy — he'i okuapy.

examples.source: But Yahweh said, “Should I hide from Abraham what I am about to do,
examples.gold: Senhor aipoe'i ojeupe ae: — Ndaikuaa ukai 'rã ri nda'u Abraão pe mba'e pa ajapo taa?

examples.source: Then they cried out again and said, “Not this man, but Barabbas.” Now Barabbas was a robber.
examples.gold: Ha'e javive ojapukai reve ombovai: — Peva'e'ỹ, epoi Barrabás — he'i okuapy. Barrabás ma jojuka rive va'ety.

examples.source: “To what, then, can I compare the people of this generation? What are they like?
examples.gold: — Mba'e nunga re nda'u ambojoja 'rã aỹgua kuery reko? Marã rami nda'u ha'e kuery ikuai?

examples.source: Yahweh brought us out of Egypt with a mighty hand, with an outstretched arm, with great fearsomeness, with signs, and with wonders;
examples.gold: Ha'e rami vy Egito yvy gui Senhor orerenoẽ opo oupi py opo'akaa oexa uka reve, ha'e nhomondyipaarã ojapo reve, mba'emo kuaa ukaarã ha'e hexa pyrã reve.

examples.source: Just then a man in their synagogue who had an unclean spirit cried out,
examples.gold: Are'ỹ'i re onhembo'eaty py ou peteĩ ava nhe'ẽ vai onhemondea va'e. Ha'e va'e ma ojapukai atã:

examples.source: All your rulers fled away together, but they were captured without using a bow; all of them were captured together, though they had fled far away.
examples.gold: Ndea pygua yvatekueve ojavapa vyvoi teĩ ombo'apaa guyrapa e'ỹ re. Ndea pygua ovaexĩa ma guive rã ombo'apaa, mombyry ma oo teĩ.

examples.source: I will set my face against you, and you will be overpowered by your enemies. Men who hate you will rule over you, and you will run away, even when no one is chasing you.
examples.gold: Penderovaigua xee voi aiko ramo penderovaigua kuery pendejuka 'rã. Pendere ija'e e'ỹ va'e kuery onhembouvixa rei 'rã pende'áry, ha'e mava'eve penemonhaa e'ỹ teĩ penhamba rive 'rã.

examples.source: he left the linen garment and ran away naked.
examples.gold: ajukue puku gui ojepe'a vy ojava avi ovy ipire rei reve.

examples.source: If a house is divided against itself, that house will not be able to stand.
examples.gold: Peteĩ oo pygua meme joe opu'ã vy nhomomba avi 'rã.

cells.candidate: Ha'e rami vy ha'e kuery re nhe'ẽ vai onhemondea va'e opo vy ipo'aka ha'e kuery ha'e javive re. Opa marã oguereko axy ramo ipire rei ha'e ijaipa rei reve onhamba oo oĩa gui.

cells.source: The evil spirit in the man leaped on the exorcists and overpowered them and beat them up. Then they fled out of that house naked and wounded.

examples.source: Then when Paul had laid his hands on them, the Holy Spirit came on them and they spoke in other languages and prophesied.
examples.gold: Ha'e kuery áry Paulo opo omoĩ ramo ha'e kuery re ou Nhe'ẽ Ky'a E'ỹ. Ha'e ramo ayvu mboae py ijayvu, Nhe'ẽ guigua omombe'u guive.

examples.source: The men who were assigned by name got up and took the prisoners, and clothed all who were naked among them with the plunder. They clothed them and gave them sandals. They gave them food to eat and drink. They treated their wounds and put the weak ones on donkeys. They took them back to their families in Jericho, (called the City of Palms). Then they returned to Samaria.
examples.gold: Ha'e rami vy hery rupi oiporavo okuapy escravo-rã ogueru pyre re opena va'erã. Ha'e ramo ha'e kuery opu'ã vy omonhemondepa ju ipire rei va'ekue-'ekue mba'emo ogueru pyre py ae. Omonhemonde, ipy ryrurã ome'ẽ, omongarupa, omboy'u ha'e oipoano porãmba. Ha'e rã kangy gui ndoguatavei va'e ma mburika'i áry omoĩ vy ogueraa Jericó “Pindoty tetã” 'ea va'e py, hexegua kuery ikuaia py. Ha'e gui ma ojevypa ju Samaria katy.

examples.source: The Arameans fled from Israel, and David killed seven hundred of their men in chariots and forty thousand horsemen. Shobak the commander of their army was wounded and died there.
examples.gold: Ha'e rami teĩ Israel kuery renonde gui Síria pygua kuery onhamba ju. Ha'e ramo Davi ojuka Síria pygua kuery va'e regua setecentos karóxa pygua ha'e quarenta mil kavaju árygua. Oipyxo avi xondaro kuery rerekoa Sobaque, ha'e rami rã ha'e pyve omano.

examples.source: I beat them into fine pieces like dust on the ground, I pulverized them like mud in the streets.
examples.gold: Ha'e ramo amongu'ipa yvy ku'i rami. Amou'ũmba, yapo tape guiguare rami amomba.

examples.source: Then I will strip her naked in the sight of her lovers, and no one will rescue her out of my hand.
examples.gold: Aỹ ma oxĩa aexa uka 'rã opena va'ekue oexaa py. Xepo gui avave rei ndogueraa jepei 'rã guive.

examples.source: Even the bravest warriors will flee naked in that day —this is Yahweh's declaration.”
examples.gold: Ha'e va'e ára ma ojeroviakue ipy'a guaxukueve ikuai va'ekue ma opire rei reve rive 'rã onhamba — he'i Senhor.

examples.source: The king gave an order, and they brought those men who had accused Daniel and threw them into the den of lions—they, their children, and their wives. Before they reached the floor, the lions overpowered them and broke all their bones to pieces.
examples.gold: Ha'e ramo huvixave ma teĩgue ju ijayvu vy ogueru ruka avakue Daniel re ijayvu rei va'ekue. Ha'e ramo yvykua guary kuery ikuaia py omombo ukapa, ta'y kuery ha'e ta'yxy kuery reve. Ha'e gui yvy py ovaẽ e'ỹ re guary kuery ojukapa, ikãgue omopẽmba guive.

examples.source: Then the men guarding Jesus mocked and beat him.
examples.gold: Jesus rerekoa kuery ojavyky rei, oungapa guive.

examples.source: When every man of Israel in the valley saw that they had fled, and that Saul and his sons were dead, they abandoned their cities and fled. Then the Philistines came and lived in them.
examples.gold: Ha'e gui avakue Israel regua yvyugua rupi hekoa va'e oexa okuapy oirũ kuery onhambaa, ha'e Saul gua'y kuery reve omanomba maa. Ha'e rami vy ha'e kuery voi guekoa oejapa vy onhamba avi oje'oivy. Ha'e gui filisteu kuery ou vy ha'e py ju ikuai.

examples.source: Then they called the apostles in and beat them and commanded them not to speak in the name of Jesus, and let them go.
examples.gold: Ha'e gui ma apóstolo kuery oenoĩ ju vy oinupãmba. Ha'e vy ha'e kuery pe ijayvu ijayvu ve'ỹ aguã Jesus rery rupi. Ha'e gui opoipa ju.

examples.source: He also sent yet a third and they also wounded him, and threw him out.
examples.gold: — Ha'e gui mboapya ma ombou. Ha'e va'e re voi ojeaipa ma rire omoxẽ ju avi.

examples.source: He got up and immediately took up the mat, and went out of the house in front of everyone, so that they were all amazed and they gave glory to God, and they said, “We never saw anything like this.”
examples.gold: Ha'e ramove opu'ã vy oupi ngupa ituiaty, ha'e oẽ ovy pavẽ oexaa gui. Ha'e kuery onhemondyipa vy ombojerovia Nhanderuete. Ha'e vy aipoe'i okuapy: — Guĩ ramigua jaexa va'e'ỹ teri aỹ peve.

examples.source: All Israel around them fled from their cries. They exclaimed, “The earth may swallow us up also!”
examples.gold: Ha'e ramo Israel kuery ha'e kuerya katy'i rupi ikuai va'ekue onhamba oje'oivy haxẽmba rã oendu vy, “Tove yvy tanhanemomba heravy eme avi” he'i vy.

examples.source: he left the linen garment and ran away naked.
examples.gold: ajukue puku gui ojepe'a vy ojava avi ovy ipire rei reve.

examples.source: God sent an evil spirit between Abimelech and the leaders of Shechem. The leaders of Shechem betrayed the trust they had with Abimelech.
examples.gold: Nhanderuete ombou peteĩ nhe'ẽ Abimeleque ha'e Siquém pygua kuery reve joe ija'e e'ỹ aguã rami nhomoingoarã. Ha'e ramo ha'e kuery nhemi rupi ikuai Abimeleque rovai.

examples.source: But there were Jewish exorcists traveling through the area. They called on the name of the Lord Jesus so they could have power over evil spirits when they said, “By the Jesus whom Paul proclaims, I command you to come out.”
examples.gold: Ha'e gui amongue judeu kuery nhe'ẽ vai pe'aa rupi ikuai va'e ma onhea'anga Senhor Jesus rery rupi nhe'ẽ vai oipe'a aguã. Ha'e vy aipoe'i: — Xee aipoa'e pejepe'a aguã Jesus rery Paulo omombe'u va'e rupi — he'i.

examples.source: One man alone can be overpowered, but two can withstand an attack, and a three-strand rope is not quickly broken.
examples.gold: Ha'e rami ae avi peteĩ'i re opu'ãa vy ipo'akaa 'rã, ha'e rã mokoĩ ikuai vy ojoko 'rã. Ixã mboapy ombojoyvy pyre rã nomondoa voi 'rã.

examples.source: Then Isaac went up from there to Beersheba.
examples.gold: Ha'e gui Berseba katy ju oo.

cells.candidate: Nhe'ẽ vai ava'i py oĩ va'e opo nhe'ẽ vai pe'aa kuery ári, ha'e kuery re ipo'aka vy oinupãmba. Ha'e gui ha'e kuery onhamba oẽ ovy oo gui ipire rei reve ha'e ojeaipa.

cells.source: Most of the brothers have far more confidence in the Lord because of my chains, and they have courage to fearlessly speak the word.

examples.source: For in Christ we have boldness and access with confidence because of our faith in him.
examples.gold: Ha'e rami rire hexe vy nhandepy'a guaxu Nhanderuete re nhanhemboja aguã, mba'eta aỹ jaikuaa ete hexe jajerovia ramo nhanemboaxya.

examples.source: Say to the people of Ammon, 'Hear the word of the Lord Yahweh. This is what the Lord Yahweh says: Because you said, “Aha!” over my sanctuary when it was profaned, and against the land of Israel when it was desolate, and against the house of Judah when they went into exile,
examples.gold: Aipo're Amom ra'y kuery pe: Pendu ke Senhor Nhanderuete ayvu. Po rami ijayvu: Peẽ kuery ma xevygua oo iky'a e'ỹ va'e omongy'apaa rã “Ha'evea rami!” peje va'ekue, Israel yvy ombovaipaa, ha'e Judá kuery escravo-rã ogueraapaa ramo.

examples.source: Take courage, and be men, you Philistines, or you will become slaves to the Hebrews, as they have been slaves to you. Be men, and fight.”
examples.gold: Filisteu kuery, penembaraete ke ha'vy! Avakue ipy'a guaxukueve peiko, hebreu kuery pegua escravo nhandekuai e'ỹ aguã, ha'e kuery nhande-escravo ikuaiague rami e'ỹ! Avakue ipy'a guaxukueve nhandekuai reve jaje'oi joe nhapu'ã aguã! — he'i okuapy.

examples.source: For you, Yahweh, are most high above all the earth. You are exalted far above all gods.
examples.gold: Mba'eta ndee anho Senhor Yvate ete va'e reiko, yvy jave re ndepo'aka va'e. Ndee ma tuuete ikuai va'e áryve reĩ va'e.

examples.source: Therefore we must give far more attention to what we have heard, so that we do not drift away from it.
examples.gold: Ha'e nunga rupi anhetẽ ete va'e nhaendu vy nhamoĩ porã pota 'rã nhandejee, ha'e va'e rupi nhandekuaia gui jajepe'a e'ỹ aguã.

examples.source: Others had testing in mocking and whippings, and even chains and imprisonment.
examples.gold: Ha'e gui amboae kuery ju ombojarua rei rã ikuai axy rei, oinupãa, oipokuaa, ha'e nhuã py ombotya ramo.

examples.source: Pray together for us also, that God would open a door for the word, to speak the secret truth of Christ. Because of this, I am chained up.
examples.gold: Ha'e rami nhavõ orere guive pejerure, peteĩ okẽ Nhanderuete oipe'a aguã, Cristo regua ayvu ndoikuaa ukaai teria rupi romombe'u aguã. Ha'e rami aikoa re ae aĩ nhuã py.

examples.source: he met brothers of Ahaziah king of Judah. Jehu said to them, “Who are you?” They answered, “We are brothers of Ahaziah, and we are going down to greet the children of the king and the children of Queen Jezebel.”
examples.gold: nhovaexĩ Judá pygua huvixakue Acazias retarã kuery reve. Ha'e vy oporandu ha'e kuery pe: — Mava'e kuery peẽ? Ha'e kuery ombovai: — Acazias rãgue'i retarã kuery roiko. Oreruvixakue ra'y kuery roexa aguã rima roje'oi, ha'e ixykue pi'a kuery voi — he'i okuapy.

examples.source: In the beginning, God created the heavens and the earth.
examples.gold: Jypy'i ma Nhanderuete ojapo raka'e yva ha'e yvy.

examples.source: But she has in wickedness rejected my decrees more than the nations have, and my statutes more than the countries that surround her. The people have rejected my judgments and have not walked in my statutes.”
examples.gold: Ha'e rami teĩ ha'e kuery xee aipota va'e rovai opu'ã vy yvy regua kuery gui voi ojapo vaive tema okuapy, ha'e oyvýry rupi ikuai va'e gui omboykepave xeayvu aeja va'ekue. Hexaraipa okuapy xee aipotaa gui, xeayvu rupi nda'ikuai guive.

examples.source: But the people who followed Omri were stronger than the people who followed Tibni son of Ginath. So Tibni died, and Omri became king.
examples.gold: Ha'e gui Onri rupive oje'oi va'ekue ma ipo'aka okuapy Ginate ra'y Tibni rupive oo va'ekue re. Ha'e gui Tibni omano ramo Onri ae ju opena.

examples.source: For the message about the cross is foolishness to those who are dying. But among those whom God is saving, it is the power of God.
examples.gold: Anhetẽ kuruxu ayvu regua ma okanhy aguã rami ikuai va'e pe ovare'ỹ va'e merami. Ha'e rã nhande jaa jepe va'e pe ma Nhanderuete po'akaa oĩa.

examples.source: Yahweh made his people fruitful, and made them stronger than their enemies.
examples.gold: Nhanderuete ojapo ojeupegua kuery ta'y reta aguã rami, ojapo imoingo axya kuery gui imbaraeteve aguã rami.

cells.candidate: Mba'eta Nhanderuete re ovare'ỹ va'e ma yvypóry kuery arandu gui 'aranduve va'e, ha'e Nhanderuete ikangy va'e ma yvypóry kuery ikangy gui imbaraeteve va'e.

cells.source: For the foolishness of God is wiser than people, and the weakness of God is stronger than people.

examples.source: The servants of the king of Aram said to him, “Their god is a god of the hills. That is why they were stronger than we were. But now let us fight against them in the plain, and surely we will be stronger than they are.
examples.gold: Ha'e gui Síria pygua huvixa rembiguai kuery aipoe'i okuapy ixupe: — Israel kuery ruete nhi'ã yvyty rupi rive ipo'aka va'e. Ha'e nunga rupi ae ipo'aka karamboae nhande kuery re. Ha'e rã yvy joja reia rupi ri ha'e kuery rovai nhapu'ã vy nhande ju 'rã jaity ha'e kuery.

examples.source: who teaches us more than he teaches the beasts of the earth, and who makes us wiser than the birds of the sky?'
examples.gold: Ha'e ma yvy rupi vixo ikuai va'e gui nhanderekombo'eve va'e, ha'e guyra yvate rupi oveve va'e gui nhanemo'aranduve va'e”, nde'i.

examples.source: For the wisdom of this world is foolishness with God. For it is written, “He catches the wise in their craftiness.”
examples.gold: Mba'eta kova'e yvy regua 'arandu ma Nhanderuete pe rã ovare'ỹ va'e. Ha'e nunga rupi ipara oiny: “Nhanderuete oitypa 'rã hi'arandu va'e ha'e kuery ae 'arandua py.”

examples.source: And I was with you in weakness, and in fear, and in much trembling.
examples.gold: Xekangy, ajererokyje ha'e aryryipa reve aiko va'ekue peẽ kuery mbyte.

examples.source: But he said to me, “My grace is enough for you, for power is made perfect in weakness.” So I would much rather boast about my weakness, so that the power of Christ might reside on me.
examples.gold: Ha'e rami teĩ aipoe'i xevy: “Xee romboaxya ha'eve ma ndevy, mba'eta ikangy va'e re xepo'akaa ojekuaa porãve 'rã”, he'i va'ekue. Ha'e nunga rupi avy'a reve 'rã xeayvu xekangya re, xere Cristo po'akaa oĩ aguã.

examples.source: Then Yahweh sent poisonous snakes among the people. The snakes bit the people; many people died.
examples.gold: Ha'e ramo ha'e kuery mbyte rupi Senhor ombou mboi inharõve va'e, ixu'upaarã. Ha'e ramo heta omano Israel kuery va'e regua.

examples.source: When righteous people increase, the people rejoice, but when a wicked person is the ruler, the people sigh.

cells.source: As for you, the anointing that you received from him remains in you, and you do not need anyone to teach you. But as his anointing teaches you everything and is true and is not a lie, and just as it has taught you, remain in him.

examples.source: For if I boasted to him about you, I was not embarrassed. On the contrary, just as everything we said to you was true, our boasting about you to Titus proved to be true.
examples.gold: Mba'eta ixupe xeayvu va'ekue peẽ kuery roguerovy'aa rami, ha'e gui nda'evei nho ndaikoi. Mba'eta opa mba'e py pendereve oreayvua anhetẽ memea rami avi Tito oendua py roguerovy'aague voi anhetẽ ojeupitypa.

examples.source: I did not write to you because you do not know the truth, but because you know it and because no lie is from the truth.
examples.gold: Kova'e kuaxia pẽvy ambopara “Anhetẽ va'e ndapeikuaai” ha'e vy e'ỹ. Mba'eta peikuaa ae, ha'e peikuaa avi apu ikuai va'e anhetẽ va'e guigua e'ỹa.

examples.source: It happened when Jesus was praying in a certain place, one of his disciples said to him, “Lord, teach us to pray just as John taught his disciples.”
examples.gold: Peteĩ ára Jesus onhembo'e oiny peteĩ henda py. Ijayvupa ma jave peteĩ hemimbo'e ojerure ixupe: — Senhor, orembo'e na ronhembo'e kuaa aguã re, João guemimbo'e kuery ombo'eague rami avi.

examples.source: Jesus said to him, “He who is bathed has no need, except to wash his feet, but he is completely clean; you are clean, but not everyone.”
examples.gold: Jesus aipoe'i ixupe: — Ha'e rami avi amongue ojaupa ma va'ekue opy anho ojoi uka teĩ ha'eve, nda'iky'avei vy. Peẽ kuery voi napendepy'a ky'avei ma aỹ, va'eri ha'e javive e'ỹ ta'vy — he'i.

examples.source: He guides the humble in what is right and he teaches them his way.
examples.gold: Yvyĩgueve ma ha'e oguereko 'rã teko porã rupi, ombo'e 'rã ojeguigua tape rupi oiko aguã re.

examples.source: Also, we have known and believed the love that God has for us. God is love, and the one who remains in this love remains in God, and God remains in him.
examples.gold: Nhande kuery jaikuaa ha'e jarovia guive Nhanderuete nhanderayvua. Nhanderuete porayvua rupi oiko va'e ramo porayvu rupigua ikuai va'e ma hexe meme ikuai, ha'e ha'e kuery re Nhanderuete avi oĩ.

examples.source: But you have an anointing from the Holy One, and you all know the truth.
examples.gold: Ha'e rã pendere ma oĩ penemo'aranduarã Iky'a e'ỹ va'e omoĩ va'ekue. Ha'e rami rire peẽ kuery peikuaapa.

examples.source: By this we know that we remain in him and he in us, because he has given us some of his Spirit.
examples.gold: Po rami jaikuaa 'rã hexe nhaĩa, ha'e ha'e voi nhandere oĩa, mba'eta nhandereve guarã ombou Onhe'ẽ.

examples.source: for I have given them all the words that you gave me. They received them and truly knew that I came from you, and they believed that you sent me.
examples.gold: Ha'e kuery pe xee amombe'u ma ayvu remombe'u uka va'ekue. Ha'e ramo ha'e kuery oguerovia, oikuaa guive anhetẽ ete ndea gui ajuague, ndee xembou rã.

examples.source: Regarding brotherly love, you have no need for anyone to write to you, for you yourselves are taught by God to love one another.
examples.gold: Irmão kuery peayvu aguã re ambopara e'ỹ teĩ ha'eve, mba'eta Nhanderuete ae penembo'e peteĩ-teĩ pejoayvu aguã re.

cells.candidate: Ha'e rã pendere oĩ va'e ma ha'e gui peraa va'ekue penemo'aranduarã, ha'e penoĩ meme. Ha'e rami rire avave penembo'e aguã re peikotevẽi. Ha'e rã penemo'aranduarã va'e ma opa mba'e re penembo'e, anhetẽ va'e ha'e apu e'ỹ va'e. Ha'e rami avi penembo'eague rami peiko meme hexe.

examples.gold: — Ha'e rami teĩ mava'eve ndoikuaa potai, nanhomongetaai guive. Mba'eta peẽ kuery ma sacerdote kuery ojou vaipy rami pendekuai.

examples.source: I assume that you have heard about him, and that you were taught in him, as the truth is in Jesus.
examples.gold: Mba'eta anhetẽ ae Jesus regua anhetẽ va'e pendu, ha'e ha'e rupi ete penembo'ea.

examples.source: For if I boasted to him about you, I was not embarrassed. On the contrary, just as everything we said to you was true, our boasting about you to Titus proved to be true.

examples.source: Be rooted in him, be built on him, be established in faith just as you were taught, and abound in thanksgiving.
examples.gold: Hexe vy peĩ atã yvyra hapo porã va'e, ha'e oo omboyta porã mbyre rami avi. Pejeroviaa re penembaraete penembo'eague rami, ha'e perovy'a riaeve tema Nhanderuete.

examples.source: As you received Christ the Lord, walk in him.
examples.gold: Ha'e gui Senhor Jesus Cristo pemovaẽague rami avi hexe tema pendekuai.

examples.source: For though by this time you should be teachers, you still have need for someone to teach you the basic principles of God's messages. You need milk, not solid food!
examples.gold: Mba'eta yma ma pejerovia teĩ penhombo'e kuaa 'rãgue py peikotevẽ teri Nhanderuete ayvu jypy guare, haxy e'ỹve va'e re penembo'e va'erã. Ha'e rami vy kyrĩgue'i okambu va'e rami teri pendekuai, tembi'u tykue'ỹ va'e ho'u va'e rami e'ỹ.

examples.source: For my flesh is true food, and my blood is true drink.
examples.gold: Mba'eta xero'o ma tembi'u anhetẽ va'e, ha'e xeruguy ma oy'u pyrã anhetẽ va'e.

examples.source: A faithful witness does not lie, but a false witness breathes out lies.
examples.gold: Anhetẽ rupi joeko mombe'ua nda'ijapui 'rã, ha'e rã anhetẽ rupi e'ỹ nhomombe'u va'e ma opa mba'e py 'rã ijapu.

examples.source: The one who keeps God's commandments remains in him, and God remains in him. By this we know that he remains in us, by the Spirit whom he gave to us.
examples.gold: Nhanderuete ojapo uka va'e rupi ikuai va'e ma hexe anho tema ikuai, ha'e gui ha'e kuery re ma Nhanderuete voi oĩ. Po rami 'rã jaikuaa nhandere oĩa, Inhe'ẽ nhandere omoĩ va'ekue gui ae.

examples.source: But you, Yahweh, live forever, and your fame is for all generations.
examples.gold: Ha'e rã ndee Senhor, raka'e rã peve 'rã reiko. Nderery re ima'endu'aa 'rã avakue okuave teria ja.

examples.source: The bellows are scorched by the fire that is burning them; the lead is consumed in the flames. The refining continues among them, but it is useless, because the evil is not removed.
examples.gold: Mba'eta tata áry prata ky'a'oa oipeju atã teĩ chumbo anho rei opyta tata opa rire. Aiky'a'o nhea'ã rive, ha'e kuery mbyte gui heko vai va'e ndojepe'ai ramo.

examples.source: No one who remains in him will keep on sinning. No one who continues to sin has seen him or known him.
examples.gold: Hexe ikuai va'e ma ndojejavy riaevei ma 'rã. Ha'e rã jejavya rupi ikuai va'e ma ndoexai, neĩ ndoikuaai okuapy.

examples.source: Herod questioned Jesus in many words, but Jesus answered him nothing.
examples.gold: Ha'e rami vy opa marã re oporandu teĩ Jesus mba'eve py nombovai.

examples.source: He has cast lots for their places, and his hand has measured it out for them by a cord. They will possess it forever; from generation to generation they will live there.
examples.gold: Mba'eta oexa ma ixortea ha'e kuery ikuai aguã oa'anga vy, opo py ijyvyrã omboja'o ixã py. Ha'e py ae ha'e kuery ikuai 'rã raka'e rã peve, ta'y kuery jevy-jevy peve ikuai 'rã ha'e py.

examples.source: Call them to mind, my God, because they have defiled the priesthood, and the covenant of the priesthood and the Levites.
examples.gold: Xeruete, eikuaa pota ha'e kuery re, mba'eta omongy'apa sacerdote ikuaia regua, sacerdote ha'e levita kuery rekorã reja va'ekue guive.

examples.source: He was trying to see who Jesus was, but could not see over the crowd, because he was small in height.
examples.gold: Ha'e va'e oexaxe mava'e pa Jesus, teĩ nda'evei heta va'e kuery gui, ikarape'i va'e vy.

examples.source: I looked, and I heard an eagle that was flying overhead calling out with a loud voice, “Woe, woe, woe, to those who live on the earth, because of the remaining trumpet blasts that are about to be sounded by the three angels.”
examples.gold: Ha'e ramo ama'ẽ vy aendu peteĩ taguato tuvixa va'e yva mbyte rupi oveve vy ijayvu rã. Ijayvu atã reve aipoe'i: — Nda'evei ete, nda'evei ete, nda'evei ete 'rã yvy regua kuery pe, mboapy anjo mimby guaxu omonhe'ẽ va'erã oime teri ramo.

examples.source: the fifth to Malchijah, the sixth to Mijamin,
examples.gold: peteĩ nhiruĩa ma Malquias, mboapy memea ma Miamim,

examples.source: then I will have a reply for the one who mocks me, for I trust in your word.

examples.source: Oh, the depth of the riches both of the wisdom and the knowledge of God! How unsearchable are his judgments, and his ways beyond discovering!
examples.gold: Opa mba'e py Nhanderuete 'arandua ha'e oikuaapaa ma opa va'erã e'ỹ. Mba'eta ipy'aa ma ndajaikuaai ae, heko re voi ndajaikuaa pota kuaai.

examples.source: This water that brings the curse will go into your stomach and make your abdomen swell and your thighs waste away.' The woman is to reply, 'Yes, let that happen if I am guilty.'
examples.gold: Ha'e rami vy kova'e yy ayvu vaipy nhomoingoarã nderyepy rupi oike ramo ta'irurupa, ha'e ta'ivaipa nde'u”, he'i 'rã. Ha'e ramo kunha va'e “Ha'eve va'e, ha'eve va'e!” he'i 'rã.

examples.source: The sixth angel sounded his trumpet, and I heard a voice coming from the horns of the golden altar that is present before God.
examples.gold: Ha'e gui anjo mboapy memea ju omonhe'ẽ mimby guaxu. Ha'e gui aendu peteĩ ayvu. Ha'e va'e ma ouro guigua altar Nhanderuete renonde oĩ va'e apy irundy oĩ va'e gui onhendu.

examples.source: They were singing the song of Moses, the servant of God, the song of the Lamb: “Great and marvelous are your deeds, Lord God, the Almighty. Just and true are your ways, King of the nations.
examples.gold: oporaei okuapy Nhanderuete rembiguai Moisés ha'e Vexa'i ra'y poraei. Ha'e rami vy aipoe'i: — Senhor Oreruete Ndepo'akapa va'e, mba'emo rejapo va'e ma tuvixa ha'e iporã va'e meme. Reikoa ha'e javi rupi ndereko porãa anhetẽ rupigua meme rexa uka. Yvy regua kuery Ruvixave reiko!

examples.source: His judgments are true and just, for he has judged the great prostitute who corrupted the earth with her sexual immorality. He has taken revenge for the blood of his servants, which she herself shed.”
examples.gold: Anhetẽ rupi, ha'evea rami meme nhombopaga, mba'eta ombopaga ma kunha itavy rei ete va'ekue. Ha'e va'e ma itavy reia py omongy'apa va'ekue yvy regua kuery, ha'e opo py ae Nhanderuete rembiguai kuery ruguy omoẽ va'ekue teĩ ombopaga ma ha'e nungakue re — he'i.

examples.source: from Abel's blood to the blood of Zechariah, who was killed between the altar and the sanctuary. Yes, I say to you, this generation will be held responsible.
examples.gold: Abel ruguy omoẽague guive'i Zacarias ruguy omoẽa peve. Ha'e va'e ma Nhanderuete ropy altar oĩ va'e yvýry ojukaa va'ekue. Ha'e nunga rupi xee aipoa'e porãve pẽvy: Aỹgua kuery ae 'rã opaga ha'e nungakue re.

examples.source: Then I heard his words—and as I heard them, I fell on my face in deep sleep with my face to the ground.
examples.gold: Ha'e rami teĩ aendu porã ijayvu nhendu va'e. Aendu vyve ha'a, xerova yvy re amovaẽ reve ndaikuaavei ranhe ajupy.

examples.source: The path of the righteous is level, Righteous One; the path of the righteous you make straight.
examples.gold: “Heko porã va'e oguataa ma ijoja porã rei va'e meme. Ndee ndereko porã va'e ae rembojoja porã 'rã heko porã va'e oiko aguã.

cells.candidate: Ha'e gui aendu avi altar gui ombovai va'e: — Anhetẽ, Senhor Oreruete Ndepo'akapa va'e. Anhetẽ va'e ha'e ha'evea rami meme renhombopaga — he'i.
